title: 归园田居·其一
titlePy: Guī Yuán Tián Jū · Qí Yī
author: 陶渊明
intro: After years in government jobs he hated, Tao Yuanming quits and goes home to farm. Here he walks us round his little place — the thatched house, the willows, smoke over the village, a dog barking down the lane — and breathes: free at last.
analysis: 这是陶渊明辞官回乡后写的组诗第一首，写他回到田园的喜悦。开头说自己从小就不会迎合世俗，天性喜爱山林，却误入官场这张“尘网”，一去就是很多年。接着用两个比喻：笼中的鸟想念从前的树林，池里的鱼想念原来的深潭——这正是他做官时的心情。中间八句像一幅田园画：十几亩宅地，八九间草屋，榆树柳树遮着后屋檐，桃树李树排在堂前；远处的村庄模模糊糊，村子里的炊烟轻轻飘着；深巷里狗在叫，桑树顶上鸡在鸣。这些都是最普通的农村景物，在他笔下却安静、亲切。最后四句回到心情：家里没有杂事打扰，屋里空空的，人很清闲；在“樊笼”（鸟笼）里关了那么久，终于又回到了自然。开头的“尘网”和结尾的“樊笼”前后呼应。“守拙”是说保持自己笨拙、不会投机取巧的本性，这正是陶渊明的人生选择。这首诗语言平淡，却越读越有味道，是中国田园诗的代表作。
analysisEn: This is the first in a series Tao Yuanming wrote after resigning from office, and it is full of the joy of coming home. He begins by saying he never fitted in with the world; by nature he loved hills and mountains, yet he blundered into the “dusty net” of official life and stayed caught for years. Two comparisons show how he felt: a caged bird misses its old woods, a fish in a pond misses its deep pool. The middle eight lines are a painting of his farm: a plot of a dozen mu, a thatched house of eight or nine rooms, elms and willows shading the back eaves, peach and plum trees lined up in front. Far off, a village blurs in the haze; smoke drifts gently from its chimneys. A dog barks deep in a lane, a rooster crows from the top of a mulberry tree. These are the plainest country sights, yet he makes them feel calm and dear. The last four lines return to his mood: no clutter, no busywork, plenty of quiet time. After so long in a cage, he is back with nature. The “net” at the start and the “cage” at the end frame the whole poem. 守拙, “keeping to my clumsiness”, means refusing to play clever games for advancement — the choice that defines Tao’s life. The language is plain, but the more you read it, the more you taste: this is the model for all later Chinese poems of country life.
background: Tao Yuanming (365?–427) served in a series of minor posts before resigning for good in 405 as magistrate of Pengze, famously refusing to “bow for five pecks of rice”. He spent the rest of his life farming in poverty near Mount Lu and is regarded as the father of Chinese pastoral poetry. This series of five poems was written in 406, the year after he went home.
pronunciation: 少 shào（年轻时）；羁鸟 jī；守拙 zhuō；榆柳荫后檐 yìn（遮蔽）；暧暧 ài ài；墟里 xū；桑树颠 diān；樊笼 fán lóng。“三十年”一说应作“十三年”，读法不变。
version: 采用统编教材（高中语文必修上册）文本，全诗二十句，网站一联一行（共十行）。“一去三十年”：陶渊明从初仕到归隐约十三年，故有学者认为“三十年”是“十三年”之误，或“已十年”之误，教材仍作“三十年”。

lines.zh: 少无适俗韵，性本爱丘山。
lines.rhythm: 少无/适俗韵，性本/爱丘山
lines.py: shào wú shì sú yùn, xìng běn ài qiū shān
lines.lit: When young I had no knack for fitting in with the world; by nature I loved hills and mountains.
lines.en: Even as a boy I never fit the world’s ways; my heart belonged to the hills.
lines.tts: 绍无适俗韵，性本爱丘山。

lines.zh: 误落尘网中，一去三十年。
lines.rhythm: 误落/尘网中，一去/三十年
lines.py: wù luò chén wǎng zhōng, yī qù sān shí nián
lines.lit: By mistake I fell into the dusty net; once gone, thirty years passed.
lines.en: By mistake I fell into the world’s dusty net, and the years slipped away.

lines.zh: 羁鸟恋旧林，池鱼思故渊。
lines.rhythm: 羁鸟/恋旧林，池鱼/思故渊
lines.py: jī niǎo liàn jiù lín, chí yú sī gù yuān
lines.lit: The caged bird longs for its old woods; the pond fish misses its former pool.
lines.en: A caged bird pines for its old forest; a pond fish dreams of its deep pool.

lines.zh: 开荒南野际，守拙归园田。
lines.rhythm: 开荒/南野际，守拙/归园田
lines.py: kāi huāng nán yě jì, shǒu zhuō guī yuán tián
lines.lit: I clear wasteland at the edge of the southern fields; keeping my clumsiness, I return to garden and field.
lines.en: Now I break new ground in the southern fields — still my simple self, home on the farm.

lines.zh: 方宅十余亩，草屋八九间。
lines.rhythm: 方宅/十余亩，草屋/八九间
lines.py: fāng zhái shí yú mǔ, cǎo wū bā jiǔ jiān
lines.lit: My plot is some ten mu square; a thatched house of eight or nine rooms.
lines.en: A dozen mu of land around the house, a thatched roof over eight or nine rooms.

lines.zh: 榆柳荫后檐，桃李罗堂前。
lines.rhythm: 榆柳/荫后檐，桃李/罗堂前
lines.py: yú liǔ yìn hòu yán, táo lǐ luó táng qián
lines.lit: Elms and willows shade the back eaves; peaches and plums are ranged before the hall.
lines.en: Elms and willows shade the eaves behind; peach and plum trees line up in front.
lines.tts: 榆柳印后檐，桃李罗堂前。

lines.zh: 暧暧远人村，依依墟里烟。
lines.rhythm: 暧暧/远人村，依依/墟里烟
lines.py: ài ài yuǎn rén cūn, yī yī xū lǐ yān
lines.lit: Dim and hazy, the distant villages; soft and lingering, the smoke above the hamlet.
lines.en: Far villages blur in the haze; smoke rises slowly from the hamlet’s roofs.

lines.zh: 狗吠深巷中，鸡鸣桑树颠。
lines.rhythm: 狗吠/深巷中，鸡鸣/桑树颠
lines.py: gǒu fèi shēn xiàng zhōng, jī míng sāng shù diān
lines.lit: Dogs bark deep in the lanes; cocks crow on the tops of mulberry trees.
lines.en: A dog barks somewhere down the lane; a rooster crows from the top of a mulberry tree.

lines.zh: 户庭无尘杂，虚室有余闲。
lines.rhythm: 户庭/无尘杂，虚室/有余闲
lines.py: hù tíng wú chén zá, xū shì yǒu yú xián
lines.lit: My gate and courtyard are free of worldly clutter; in my empty rooms there is leisure to spare.
lines.en: No worldly clutter at my gate; in my bare rooms, time to spare.

lines.zh: 久在樊笼里，复得返自然。
lines.rhythm: 久在/樊笼里，复得/返自然
lines.py: jiǔ zài fán lóng lǐ, fù dé fǎn zì rán
lines.lit: Long I was inside a cage; again I can return to nature.
lines.en: So long shut up in a cage — and now I am back where I belong, with nature.

words.note: 读 shào，现代汉语有“少年”“青少年”。

words.en: a temperament that fits in with the world
the dusty net — worldly life, here official life
words.note: 比喻官场像一张网，把人困住。
羁：束缚，现代汉语有“羁绊”“不羁”。

words.en: to keep to one’s simple, unworldly nature
the house and land around it
words.note: 一说“方”是“围绕”，一说指方圆。
动词读 yìn；名词“树荫”今天读 yīn。
现代汉语有“罗列”“星罗棋布”。
现代汉语“暧昧”原义也是模糊不明。
今天多指舍不得离开，如“依依不舍”。
古义村落；今天“废墟”的“墟”指荒废的地方。
通“巅”，现代汉语有“山巅”“巅峰”。

words.en: an empty, quiet room (also a calm mind)

words.note: 比喻束缚人的处境，书面语仍用。
这里兼指大自然和不受拘束的本性；现代汉语常用。

imagery.name: 鸟
imagery.zh: 被关住的“羁鸟”想念旧林，是诗人做官时的自画像；结尾“樊笼”又呼应了这只鸟。
imagery.en: The caged bird longing for its woods is the poet in office — and the “cage” at the end brings it back.

imagery.name: 鱼
imagery.zh: 池中的鱼想念原来的深潭，和羁鸟一起写出对自由和故乡的渴望。
imagery.en: The pond fish missing its deep pool joins the bird in longing for freedom and home.

imagery.name: 柳
imagery.zh: 屋后的榆树柳树绿荫浓密，是安宁田园生活的一部分。
imagery.en: Willows and elms shading the back of the house are part of a calm country life.

imagery.name: 炊烟
imagery.zh: 村落上空轻轻飘起的炊烟，写出人间烟火的温暖与宁静。
imagery.en: Cooking smoke drifting over the village gives the scene its warmth and peace — people living simply.
